positions.title: Technical Student Specialist
positions.locationName: Community and Academic Application Development, NYU IT
positions.description: At the heart of NYU lies many enterprise applications that requires constant designing, upgrading, maintaining, and testing. As a Technical Student Specialist, I am part of a small DevOps team within NYU IT Community and Academic Application Development specializing in internal testing.

positions.title: NYUWireless Millimeter Wave Researcher
positions.description:
Millimeter Wave seems to be the next step in the future of wireless communications. These waves are extremely delicate as they can be interrupted by even our bodies, but they have the capacity to increase our bandwidth by many folds.

Our team tackles the problem of calculating millimeter wave coverage given that if several base stations are already deployed in a given room. We are testing a frustration free robot that will automatically capture coverage in a given room if left running.

positions.title: Watson Cloud Platform Intern
positions.description: IBM is a front runner in transforming businesses and financial institutions all over the world, which means that the reliability of the IBM Cloud is our utmost priority. Over my internship, I will be challenged to transform, rethink, build, and expand the existing infrastructure with industry technologies such as Kubernetes, Istio, and Cloudflare. My end of internship goal is to create a global micro-service delivery network with these technologies to improve the reliability and the resiliency of IBM Watson and Cloud Services.

volunteerExperiences.role: Cahners ComputerPlace and Hall of Human Life
volunteerExperiences.description: Everyday of working here is a different story, because I get to interact and provide informal education to guests that walks through our space. Our mission is to get visitors to learn at least one interesting new fact that they would otherwise not have known, thereby making their visit worthwhile. I participate in weekly staff workshop to expand our own knowledge in order to better assist our museum guests. Most work done here are self-directed, there will never be anyone telling me what I have to do. The most exciting part here is that I get to handle real animal and human tissue during my discussions!
